description: Lists the websites of an event the person organizes, built in the Sonar Connections site builder: each site's `siteId`, its name, whether it is published, how many earlier versions are kept, when it was last saved and published, its live address and, once it has been edited from here, its draft preview link. Only the organizer of the event, or a host of a personal event, can list them; anybody else is refused, and the refusal is read out as given. It needs a personal connector token and changes nothing.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.

name: site_list
title: List your event websites (organizers only)
